title: A3: real requests from every existing project route to where the person went
description: The eval set (~/.foundry/pa-eval/set, built from the person's real first messages across their projects, de-identified, plus handwritten new/ask/answer cases) is replayed on a scratch copy of the dev database with the eval's own chats hidden. The assistant routes by reading .foundry/project-index.md, .foundry/projects/ and its notes; the routing answer is the workspace it dispatched to. With a real model on a sample, the §13 gates hold: clear top-1 ≥ 90%, wrong dispatch when going ahead ≤ 3%, asks on ambiguous ≥ 80%, “should create” precision and recall ≥ 85%, banned words 0, ≤ 0.2 questions per request.
preconditions: The server writes the per-project summary files (DEV-235); the e2e step also WP-P and a native model login.

steps.value: assistant sessions on a stratified sample; helpers cancelled at once
